ios.desc:
Kalkyl is just a really good calculator.

• Optimized for quick calculations.
• Collaborate on documents.
• Simple and intuitive design.
• Haptic feedback (on supported devices).
• Undo and Redo support (shake to Undo).
• Keyboard trackpad mode using 3D Touch, or Haptic Touch (on supported devices), or two fingers on iPad.
• Pointer interactions on iPad.
• Basic graphing.
• Properly localized number formatting.
• App-wide dynamic type support.
• Accessible.

Terms of Use:
https://kalkyl.io/terms.html

quotes.text:
Looks great!

If you are looking for an iOS/iPadOS app my own Kalkyl 3 includes support for shared documents with real-time collaboration.

You don’t input text (but there’s of course keyboard support), instead you input tokens so that e.g sin is one token just like the digits. 
WYSIWYG editing with raised exponents, root-overbars.
Arbitrarily complex unit conversions (e.g USD/ft^2 to EUR/m^2 is a single conversion) and dimensional analysis.

The app is free, but the document features are for pay (with a free trial):

https://apps.apple.com/se/app/kalkyl/id519933025?l=en
